Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 107. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have practiced extensively with a variety of
weapons, gaining the following benefits:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a
maximum of your current Ability Score Maximum.
You gain proficiency with four weapons of your
choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial
weapon.
